blockers.title: The asserted twelve-join refresh leaves forty stale present-tense citations in the enforcement-class payload.
blockers.claimAttacked: basedOn.relation, joinCurrencyAudit.standing, authorityClaim, and purpose say that preview-product-boundary-successor.v9 re-cites all twelve joins at the versions current at its dispatch, while enforcementEvidence.classes and sevenItems.dispositions are carried byte-identically from preview-product-boundary-successor.v8.
evidence: D-294 Decision 3 says that a successor issued for any reason refreshes its cross-lineage citations to the versions current at its dispatch.

enforcementEvidence.classes is canonically equal to preview-product-boundary-successor.v8.enforcementEvidence.classes, but each of its fourteen class objects retains v8-era current/standing sentences in existingGate and laterExecution.

The 28 existingGate/laterExecution fields contain 40 stale sites across all twelve lineages: g29-leftover-join.v3 14; g30-leftover-join.v3 6; g09-leftover-join.v10 2; language-runtime-leftover-join.v4 2; g16-leftover-join.v3 2; g21-leftover-join.v4 2; g23-leftover-join.v4 2; permission-leftover-join.v9 2; distribution-core-leftover-join.v7 2; monorepo-leftover-join.v3 2; language-quality-leftover-join.v3 2; doctor-actor-leftover-join.v11 2.

Those same bytes call the old versions current at 38 sites and say host-owned doctor probes remain on doctor-actor-leftover-join.v11 at two more sites; none of the 40 sentences is delimited as a historical quotation from preview-product-boundary-successor.v8.

The correct current versions, independently recovered from the highest non-CONTESTED COORD headings, are g29-leftover-join.v4 (D-254), g30-leftover-join.v4 (D-255), g09-leftover-join.v12 (D-288), language-runtime-leftover-join.v7 (D-274), g16-leftover-join.v5 (D-278), g21-leftover-join.v13 (D-292), g23-leftover-join.v8 (D-240), permission-leftover-join.v12 (D-283), distribution-core-leftover-join.v9 (D-287), monorepo-leftover-join.v4 (D-277), language-quality-leftover-join.v5 (D-273, with D-272 CONTESTED), and doctor-actor-leftover-join.v12 (D-285).

The stale class fields directly contradict basedOn, joinCurrencyAudit, leftoverDesignOpenStanding, and the subject's stated citation-refresh purpose. The g23 class fields additionally say leftoverDesign remains OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING even though the correctly cited g23-leftover-join.v8 has no obligation flagged leftoverDesign true.
